key_findings: Intrathecal HDAC6 inhibitor tubastatin A reduces spinal NLRP3/caspase-1, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha and astrocyte activation and relieves cancer-induced bone pain in rats.
HDAC6-NLRP3 interaction increased in CIBP spinal cord and was reduced by TSA.
